rules.baseline: unchanged oldmedian3net forecasts and decisions checked against published accounts; never used to train risk features
rules.diagnostics: allquarters/omitquarters and1/3/5bestorigin-date omissions withallstocks together; hindsight sensitivity, not tradable futuredate selection
rules.features: existing29causalvolatility/peer/basketfeatures; no trainedregimegate; everyfutureunknownpeer retained before labels
rules.filters: oldmedian3net forecast>.10 AND lossP<=.2 or<=.1; newquantilemedian>.10 AND ordered AND lossP<=.2
rules.loss: binary event ORIGINALnet<-.5pct; HGBtrain, L2sigmoid nextyearcalibration scores only; not fit on in-sample basecandidates
rules.maps: train-only classmedians and classmeans after GLOBALtrain2.5/97.5pctwinsorisation; probabilities dotmaps; test returns NEVERclipped
rules.metrics: originalnetpointMAE, quantilepinball/rawandadjustedcoverage/crossings; lossBrier/AUC vs train/calprevalence; multiclassBrier/logloss vs calibrationprevalence
rules.payoffpolicies: mean>.10; medianmap>.10; mean>.10 AND classlossP<=.2; bothmaps>.10 AND classlossP<=.2
rules.qpolicies: median>.10; risk adds ordered rawquantiles AND correctedlower>=-.5; positive_lower adds ordered AND correctedlower>0
rules.quantiles: train net/risk_scale conditional.2/.5/.8; restore originalunits; no reordering; rawcrossing vetoes interval-based entries
rules.range: calibration-only qhat=max(0,80pct finite-sample quantile of max(rawlow-y,y-rawupper)); lower=rawlow-qhat upper=rawupper+qhat; no guaranteed futurecoverage
rules.screen: same2025AND2026 >=20dates/year, positivecompletebaseline andall1/3/5bestpositive-date omissions at BOTHcosts; separateall3yearsflag
rules.training: knowntrain only; dateequalweights; train-onlyweightedStandardScaler29 clip+-8; no search/earlystop
rules.unknowns: preserve everyeligibleunknown; selectedmissingentry/exit poisons full account; no convenient known-subset profits
